name: How should I choose a contractor for interior finish repairs after a storm?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a contractor for interior finish repairs after a storm?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reliable storm-damage finish contractor must have hands-on experience in drywall installation, texturing, trim carpentry, and paint application. Look for an established local contractor who conducts thorough on-site assessments rather than offering quick estimates over the phone. Check credentials, such as a Better Business Bureau accreditation and positive client reviews. Ensure the contractor acts as a clear point of contact on-site, inspects the framing cavity for hidden moisture before closing walls, and provides written scopes covering both structural drywall repairs and final cosmetic painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced, accredited local finish contractor who inspects framing for trapped moisture and handles both drywall replacement and final painting.
